title: Alcohol and Cancer Risk in Men
subtitle: Risk reduction, screening, evidence, and practical prevention related to alcohol and cancer risk in men.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from epidemiological and mechanistic studies supports the causal link between alcohol consumption and increased cancer risk in men, with moderate evidence addressing genetic modifiers and synergistic effects with tobacco. Emerging evidence focuses on optimization of screening strategies and individualized prevention.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
